speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass; to determine the cause, please describe the characteristics of your bleeding, including the volume, duration, and any associated pain. Additionally, have you experienced any weight changes, abdominal bloating, or urinary symptoms recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial hyperplasia or endometrial carcinoma.

Given the patient's age, postmenopausal bleeding, and an adnexal mass, I am requesting an endometrial biopsy and a transvaginal ultrasound to evaluate the uterine lining and the mass. Additionally, I need a CA-125 level to help characterize the adnexal mass.
